decision: held: source inaccessible. All five declared sources (14653829, 18424099, 22746542, 28609140, 34569671) are subscription-only with no PMC/Europe PMC full text, so preparations, doses, forms, populations and primary outcomes cannot be verified as Dr. Pham's source-content hold requires.
summary: Titles and abstracts indicate a 247-patient functional-dyspepsia RCT of artichoke leaf extract, two placebo-controlled hypercholesterolaemia RCTs and two lipid meta-analyses, which fits Dr. Pham's instruction not to treat the record as preclinical-only. Without full methods no context can be completed; the record stays held.
